items.title: Babe Stovall Interview, 1974-04-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And my name is Dick Allen. Huh. Why do they call you babe?

ctx.x: Yeah, it's picking up. Going to Tulane? Yeah, it's picking it up. Right now? And my name is Dick Allen. Huh. Why do they call you babe? Huh? Who started calling you babe in a while?
Uh, that's the reason why they come to call me babe. That's the reason why they said babe's the law.
